title: Iran Says It Intercepted Seven Vessels at Hormuz, Warns ‘Enemy’ Bases in Region Could Be Targeted
text:
Iran Says It Intercepted Seven Vessels at Hormuz, Warns ‘Enemy’ Bases in Region Could Be Targeted"

"🔆🔅STRAIT OF HORMUZ — October 22, 2026 — Iran’s Army Navy and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps Navy intercepted seven vessels accused of unauthorized passage through the Strait of Hormuz over the past two days. "

""
"Voice-over, Fars Reporter (Farsi): “With the release of evening footage on October 22, 2026, we are seeing images of the strategic Strait of Hormuz and Iran's complete oversight and growing authority of its armed forces over this strategic waterway. Over the past two days, as the ‘American enemy stepped up efforts to coerce and lure some vessels into passing through the Strait of Hormuz without a permit, the strategic Navy of the Islamic Republic of Iran Army and the IRGC Navy decisively intercepted seven vessels in violation in Persian Gulf waters at the entrance to the Strait. The armed forces’ oversight of this strategic waterway continues with strength and power. The IRGC Navy also announced in a statement that if the enemy’s provocations and attempts to lure vessels into unauthorized passage through the Strait of Hormuz continue, the confrontation will extend to the enemy’s bases in the region. The authority of Iran’s armed forces over the strategic Strait of Hormuz is complete and continues with power.”
